# Dora

## Appearance

Dora is a fair, neat, and proper girl with hazel eyes and long, smooth, sleek brown curls that rarely get out of order. She has a straight nose and a prim, composed mouth. As a child, she was noted for her clean, starched dresses and tidy appearance, though she grew somewhat plump as she reached her late teens.

_Sources: [v2 c8 P0](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0000), [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c8 P47](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0047), [v3 c1 P27](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0027), [v3 c1 P32](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0032)_

## Personality

Dora is remarkably quiet, sensible, obedient, and orderly, often described as 'prunes and prisms' in her demeanor. Unlike her twin brother Davy, she is timid and well-behaved, naturally inclined to follow rules and keep things tidy without needing reprimands. Though considered by some to be a bit monotonous or lacking in vivacity, she is faithful, helpful, and placid under almost all circumstances.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c7 P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 c8 P0](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0000), [v2 c8 P12](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0012), [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c8 P47](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0047), [v2 c10 P89](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0089), [v2 c26 P33](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0033)_

## History

Dora Keith is raised in Nova Scotia and later East Grafton until her sickly, widowed mother dies. Along with her twin brother Davy, she is taken in by Marilla Cuthbert and Anne Shirley at Green Gables in Avonlea. Unlike her mischievous brother, Dora adapts effortlessly to life at Green Gables, being consistently polite, well-behaved, and helpful around the house and garden. She attends Avonlea School and Sunday School, where she excels in memorizing her lessons without fuss. As she grows up into a quiet young lady, she continues to reside at Green Gables under Marilla's and Mrs. Rachel Lynde's care, eventually inheriting Anne's old porch gable room and receiving courtships from Ralph Andrews.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029), [v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c7 P32](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0032), [v2 c8 P0](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0000), [v2 c8 P47](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0047), [v2 c13 P0](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0000), [v2 c16 P10](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0010), [v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 c24 P10](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0010), [v3 c3 P1](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0001), [v3 c36 P3](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0003), [v3 c36 P5](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0005)_
